answer: A wallet-based Sybil resistance mechanism involves requiring each AI agent to possess a unique, publicly verifiable digital wallet. This wallet must be linked to a hardware token, such as a walnut-shaped USB device, which can only be accessed by the agent's physical presence. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would have to physically wander to each location, distributing the tokens, while simultaneously withstanding the energy drain of maintaining a constant, high-speed connection, akin to a zephyr blowing through a dense forest.
